name: AI Tool Center
author: SJ Vision

sections.description:
Turn your website into a 24/7 intelligent assistant hub with NimBot by AI Tool Center.

NimBot sits quietly on your site as a modern, lightweight popup assistant — ready to answer user questions, guide visitors, or provide customer support. Powered by the flexibility of OpenAI, or your own AI API keys, NimBot enhances user engagement without heavy resources.

Key Features:
– Easy setup — no coding required
– Use your own OpenAI keys (Free Account) or our managed endpoints (Advanced Account)
– Highly customizable popup appearance
– Page-specific AI configurations
– Lightweight and fast-loading (no bloat)
– Secure API key handling

🔗 Learn more and get your membership key at AI Tool Center.

3rd Party Scripts and Services

  • Font Awesome Free 6.7.2
    Icons used within plugin UI.
    License

  • Google Fonts – Audiowave
    Font used for modern typography.
    Privacy Policy

  • CDNJS Scripts:

    • Marked.js v15.0.7 (Markdown parsing)
    • Highlight.js v11.11.1 (Syntax highlighting)
      Cloudflare Privacy Policy

  • API Responder v1.0.0
    API routing and authorization. Requires domain Referrer and Membership Key for account authorization. If using our API LLM end-point then message is sent, if using your own API LLM end-point then the message and your Your LLM URL, Your LLM API Key and the Your LLM Model to use.
    Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
From WordPress Directory
1. From your WordPress Dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
2. Search for AI Tool Center.
3. Find AI Tool Center and Install.
4. Activate AI Tool Center via the Plugins page.
5. Go to AI Tool Center menu item.
6. Enter your Membership Key to unlock features.

From Developer Website
1. Download ai-tool-center.zip from AI Tool Center.
2. From your WordPress Dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
3. Upload and install the ai-tool-center.zip file.
4. Activate AI Tool Center via the Plugins page.
5. Go to AI Tool Center menu item.
6. Enter your Membership Key to unlock features.
sections.faq:
Can I use my own ChatGPT API keys?

Yes! All Accounts will allow you to connect your OpenAI API endpoints. Basic and Advanced Accounts will also allow you to connect to custom API endpoints.

What if I don’t have AI API keys?

No problem. You can use AI Tool Center’s managed API endpoints by upgrading to a Advanced Account — no extra setup needed. Or you can visit OpenAI and setup an account there to receive some paid API endpoints.

Is NimBot compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes. NimBot is designed to work seamlessly with any modern, properly coded WordPress theme.

Does NimBot slow down my site?

No. NimBot is built lightweight with minimal resources — loading only when needed.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Major overhaul of the NimBot Agent. You can now have multiple Agents across different pages/posts. Reduction in file/plugin size as a result.
  • Introduction of Claude AI.
  • More defined control on what is deleted on plugin deactivation.
  • Can connect to OpenAI, Claude or any custom LLM for FREE.
  • Trouble Shooting tab added to settings page.
  • Membership features changed for different levels. Refer to prices Here
  • Admin styling to enhance user experience.
  • Overall user experience simplified for easy implementation.
  • More restrictions put in place for security.

1.2.0

  • LLM API overhaul.

1.1.3

  • Custom styling added to Popup and Page chat bots.

1.1.2

  • Code rewrite.
  • OpenAI and Custom API’s separated into tabs.
  • Bug fix transcript count not being sent via API.
  • Bug fix LLM API Model selector.
  • Bug fix PopUp Activation error.
  • Branding and styling.
  • Approved for WordPress Directory.

1.0.3

  • Added message ID handling and history retention settings.
  • Introduced page inclusion options for PopUp RAG.
  • Prefix added to all classes, functions and variables etc.
  • All outputs escaped for security.
  • Admin area css styling.
  • Readme.txt improvements.

1.0.2

  • Page AI and PopUp AI now operate independently.

1.0.1

  • Improved AI reply message styling and formatting.
